invulnerable_save.description: Invulnerable save values keyed by datasheet (and optionally by model). A save applies to every attack unless a typed scoped column (rangedSave/meleeSave) is populated, or the MFM importer's explicit, narrowly-defined English-footnote mapping narrows its scope.

datasheetId.description: Identifies the owning datasheet this invulnerable save belongs to.

miniatureId.description: Identifies the owning model (miniature) when the save is model-specific rather than whole-unit; null for whole-datasheet saves.

save.description: Unconditional invulnerable save: applies to all attacks unless a typed scoped column (rangedSave/meleeSave) is populated or the importer's explicit footnote mapping applies.

rangedSave.description: Attack-scoped numeric invulnerable save that applies only to ranged attacks.

meleeSave.description: Attack-scoped numeric invulnerable save that applies only to melee attacks.
